messages:
sam_vendor: Hi team - invoice `2026-UK-5500` was sent to Redwood Ltd and shows 20% VAT. Our AP says this should be zero-rated / reverse-charged because it's B2B SaaS and we're EU VAT-registered. Our VAT: GB999888777. Also our CFO asked if Redwood can gross-up for a possible 6% withholding that UK branch might apply during payout to our Polish sub. Contract has a gross-up clause but not specific rates. Need clarity before payment due.

claire_finance: Quick Qs: which Redwood legal entity is on the invoice (Redwood Ltd UK or Redwood Inc US)? If it's Redwood Ltd (UK) reverse-charge depends on buyer VAT registration. Please attach invoice PDF and the contract clause screenshot.

sam_vendor: Invoice billed to Redwood Ltd (UK). PDF attached. Clause screenshot: section 5 says "supplier may request gross-up for taxes withheld by payer." No numbers.

harry_tax: Tax note: For intra-UK payments billed to a UK entity, reverse-charge for B2B intra-EU doesn't apply (post-Brexit rules differ). If buyer is UK VAT-registered, supplier should issue net invoice only if place of supply rules require it. We need to confirm place-of-supply rules and buyer VAT. Regarding gross-up to cover 6% withholding: we require (1) evidence withholding is statutory, (2) TRC or local tax opinion, and (3) prior written approval per contract. Formula for vendor reference: `gross = net / (1 - wht_rate)`.

nina_legal: Contract reading: clause 5 is permissive but not authorizing open-ended gross-up. Legal stance: we will only gross-up to documented statutory rates with TRC and a formal request. No automatic 6% approval. If vendor wants gross-up, provide legal-calculated breakdown and TRC.

claire_finance: Action plan: 1) We will not pay VAT if place-of-supply shows it's outside UK VAT or reverse-charge applies; need buyer VAT proof. 2) We will not gross-up without docs; payment may be withheld per local law. 3) @billing-bot please put payment on hold and create reissue job to correct VAT if needed.

billing-bot: Job queued: reissue check for `2026-UK-5500` -> draft `2026-UK-5500-REVIEW` (job id 2334010025). Payment hold set. Emailing vendor for docs.

sam_vendor: Ok we'll upload buyer VAT cert and our TRC. One question: what exact wording will you use if you apply reverse-charge so our AP can match?

claire_finance: We'll use: "Reverse charge 1 VAT to be accounted for by the customer. Customer VAT ID: <buyer_vat_id>." If place-of-supply is UK domestic we may instead leave VAT blank and note "no VAT charged - place of supply: UK domestic services" depending on tax determination.

harry_tax: If TRC shows non-Polish residency for the sub and treaty applies, we can consider gross-up workflow: pay gross, supplier files claim locally and we reclaim WHT where permitted. But that's contingent on docs.

ops_prod: Flagging @sales - potential delay on vendor onboarding until payment clears.

claire_finance: Thanks all. Sam, please upload requested docs in 48h. We'll re-open thread once we have TRC/buyer VAT.

sam_vendor: Uploading now. Appreciate the rapid help.
